text.en: Cat owners express complete confidence in Jean for her professional, attentive, and dependable sitting service. Reviewers note that she takes time to meet cats and their families before trips, arriving punctually and treating home environments with great respect. Clients value her genuine dedication and calm approach, which provides total peace of mind.

Reviewers emphasize how patiently Jean interacts with nervous, elderly, or timid cats during home visits. Clients share that she spends quality time playing, chatting, and seeking out favorite hiding spots rather than merely providing food. Pet parents appreciate that she reliably administers daily medications and ensures pets remain relaxed at home.

Owners consistently commend the detailed daily communications sent during every sitting assignment. Reviews highlight reassuring morning updates, photos, and video clips that show pets settled, feeding, and playing comfortably while families are away. Clients praise how these frequent visual reports alleviate anxiety and make holidays worry-free.

q.en: Does the service conduct initial meet-and-greet visits?

a.en: Yes, Jean arranges an introductory visit beforehand to discuss routines, meet the pets, and understand individual requirements.

q.en: Can medication be administered during home visits?

a.en: Reviewers confirm that daily oral medication and health routines are reliably managed during visits.

q.en: What updates do owners receive while away?

a.en: Clients receive daily messages, photographs, and video clips showing their cats settled and cared for.
